summary: Assess stockout, excess and obsolescence risks with practical inventory methods. Explore the 5-day course and build review-ready action plans.
lede: Inventory risk management helps inventory, procurement, supply chain and finance professionals assess stock exposure and guide replenishment. This intermediate course develops practical skills in measuring demand and supplier lead-time uncertainty, calculating reorder points and comparing safety-stock scenarios. You will also prioritize SKUs with ABC-XYZ analysis and design controls for stockouts, excess, ageing and shrinkage, supporting clearer decisions about service, cost and risk ownership.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who make or support inventory decisions, manage stock controls, or report inventory exposure to operational and financial leaders.
prerequisites: Intermediate level. Practical familiarity with inventory records, stock control or replenishment is expected. No programming is required; exercises focus on inventory data interpretation, calculations and risk artefacts.
